{
  "componentSlugs": ["search-field", "empty-state"],
  "apiReferences": [
    "SearchField: value, onValueChange, placeholder",
    "EmptyState: title, description, illustration (optional)"
  ],
  "installCommands": [
    "npx shadcn@latest add @skrewww/search-field",
    "npx shadcn@latest add @skrewww/empty-state"
  ],
  "maturityClaims": [
    { "component": "search-field", "maturity": "stable" },
    { "component": "empty-state", "maturity": "beta" }
  ],
  "shapeMode": "rounded",
  "surfaceMode": "glass",
  "skrewwwRegistryConfigured": true,
  "recipeIdsUsed": [],
  "accessibilityFacts": [
    "SearchField should expose an accessible name (label or aria-label).",
    "Empty State messaging for no matches should be announced to assistive tech when results update (live region or equivalent).",
    "Decorative empty-state illustration should be aria-hidden or have empty alt."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "No Agent Kit available; composition is inferred from common @skrewww Search Field + Empty State pairing for zero results.",
    "Empty State is beta; Search Field is treated as stable unless docs say otherwise.",
    "Registry @skrewww is already configured per fixture.",
    "Shape=rounded and Surface=glass apply via configured theme/provider, not per-component props."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Exact Empty State beta API (slot vs props) not verified without Agent Kit or docs.",
    "Whether a dedicated search-no-results recipe exists is unknown under OFF.",
    "Precise maturity labels may differ from published registry metadata."
  ],
  "implementation": "Keep SearchField controlled with the current query. When the filtered result set is empty and the query is non-empty, render EmptyState below (or in place of) the results list with a title like \"No results\" and a short description that references the query. Do not clear the SearchField. Rely on project shape=rounded and surface=glass from the configured Skrewww setup. Prefer EmptyState for the zero-match UI rather than ad-hoc placeholder text."
}
